newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sporitelna, Komercni help Agrobanka crisis.
newsitem.headline: Czech Sporitelna, Komercni help Agrobanka crisis.

text.p: The heads of the largest Czech banks, Ceska Sporitelna and Komercni Banka a.s. both said on Thursday that their banks had deposited funds at Agrobanka a.s. to help relieve its liquidity crisis.

Sporitelna General Director Jaroslov Klapal told Reuters after a meeting with Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus and the heads of the four largest banks that his bank had deposited "billions" in a concerted effort to help Agrobanka, which was put under central bank forced administration earlier this week.
Komercni president Richard Salzmann told Reuters his bank had also heeded a central bank call for large banks to put funds into Agrobanka to ease it through its liquidity crunch.
"This is not a special act of granting a loan but more giving (Agrobanka) space on the money market," Salzmann said.

The heads of the other two banks represented at the lunchtime meeting with the prime minister -- Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s. and Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. -- were not immediately available for individual comment.

The central bank put Agrobanka under "temporary" forced administration and guaranteed all its obligations on Tuesday becaue of liquidity problems brought on by the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s. with which Agrobanka had strong ties.
